items.title: Nails by Sharline
items.summary: A nail service website I designed and developed for a local business, helping clients explore services and contact the owner through Facebook.

image.alt: Nails by Sharline website with nail color previews and nail services

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: A local nail business needed one clear place to show its services and take inquiries.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Designed and built the whole site, from the first layout to launch.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: Services and nail colours up front, with one tap to message the owner on Facebook.

items.title: ASINTA
items.summary: A workforce platform for security agencies. I build duty scheduling, secure guard check-in and role-based workflows across admin, guard and client portals.

image.alt: ASINTA landing page hero with workforce operations headline and a 3D security site model

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: Security agencies juggle schedules, guard check-ins and client updates across separate tools.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Full-stack developer in a five-person Scrum team.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: Admin, guard and client portals on one Firebase backend, with location-verified check-in and role-based access.

items.title: Modern Way Redesign
items.summary: A website redesign I proposed for a virtual assistant agency, built around the US–Manila time difference with clear services, pricing comparison and a free delegation plan.

image.alt: Modern Way redesign hero with the headline Your workday ends, theirs begins, and a New York to Manila time arc

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: A virtual assistant agency needed US clients to see the Manila time difference as an advantage.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Proposed, designed and built the redesign.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: Lead with the time difference, then clear services, a pricing comparison and a free delegation plan.

items.title: AyosPapel
items.summary: A landing page I proposed for a client's receipt-to-SLSP tool, with an interactive demo where sample receipts fill the quarterly sales and purchases list.

image.alt: AyosPapel landing page hero with the headline Resibo in, SLSP out, and extracted TIN and VAT tags

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: Turning a pile of receipts into the quarterly SLSP is slow, manual work.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Designed and built the landing page proposal.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: An interactive demo where sample receipts fill the sales and purchases list, so visitors see the result in seconds.

items.title: Off Axis
items.summary: A small collection of 3D spatial puzzles that run in the browser. Roll, the first puzzle, is playable with six practice levels.

image.alt: Off Axis home with 3D previews of the Roll and Unlink puzzles

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: I wanted puzzles that make you think in 3D, right in the browser, with nothing to install.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Designed and built it.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: React, Three.js and Supabase. Roll, the first puzzle, has six practice levels; the second is on the way.

items.title: Universal Web Dev
items.summary: A free skill that helps AI coding assistants plan, build and check websites before they launch.

image.alt: Universal Web Dev banner with its one-message install command

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: AI-built websites tend to look the same and skip launch basics like phone layouts and broken links.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Created it and keep it updated.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: It began as Zero to Deploy, a planning website. Now it lives inside your AI: one install, 33 vetted skills and a Launch Readiness Score at the end.

items.title: Nexus Pass
items.summary: An interactive digital pass that works directly in the browser.

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: Event passes are easy to lose and hard to check at the door.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Designed and built the demo.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: Fill a short form and get a live digital pass with a role, access level, QR code and a tap-to-scan check.

items.title: This Portfolio
items.summary: Framework-free and JSON-driven, designed and built from scratch.

caseStudy.label: Challenge
caseStudy.text: One place to show both my websites and my video work, without slowing down.

caseStudy.label: My role
caseStudy.text: Designed and built it from scratch.

caseStudy.label: Approach
caseStudy.text: Built from scratch with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so it stays fast. Live view counts update on their own.
